verdict_reason: All in-scope deliverables are implemented and verified. Three criteria are qualified: one is blocked by an operator credential decision, one is a pre-existing corpus conformance gap that this WP deliberately did not resolve by fabricating metadata, and one is a pre-existing BLOCKED preflight state unchanged by this work.

criteria.criterion: current state artifact is produced and validated before the ideal state artifact is updated
criteria.evidence: docs/state/CSA_KAD_PI_CURRENT.{json,md} rewritten in Phase A (2026-09-11T14:36:41Z) with probe-backed nodes; baseline preserved as CSA_KAD_PI_CURRENT_2026-09-11.{md,json}; ISA work began only after node --test docs/state/test/state-artifacts.test.mjs reported 9/9.

criteria.criterion: the current state artifact records a probe-backed memory substrate node with evidence
criteria.evidence: knowledge_plane.memory_substrate carries state_class VERIFIED_CURRENT plus evidence {source: COMMAND, command, path}; the test that walks the document for state_class-without-evidence passes.

criteria.criterion: ai-memory is the wiki of record and vault/ is a deterministically regenerated mirror
criteria.evidence: bin/kad-memory status: record resolves; publish regenerates vault/ and is gated on ai-memory export-okf; vault/index.md declares okf_version "0.2"; vault/.obsidian absent; vault/_meta.md present; 192 markdown files. evidence/WP-KAD-MEMORY-SUBSTRATE-057/mirror-2026-09-11.txt

criteria.criterion: vault-derived tooling fails closed when pointed at the derived mirror
criteria.evidence: KAD_VAULT=$PWD/vault bin/kad-wiki rebuild|propose|ingest each exit 1 with an explicit 'derived mirror' message; the same propose against the record exits 0; read-only lint still works against the mirror. mirror-2026-09-11.txt

criteria.criterion: the OpenViking runtime path is retired and replaced by a PROPOSED-only ai-memory adapter
criteria.evidence: tools/kad/research-openviking.mjs and its test deleted; createAiMemoryAccessAdapter exported (authority false, records always PROPOSED with source_ref + source_hash; unreachable/401/missing-token degrade without throwing); 9/9 adapter tests pass; config registry entries marked RETIRED; historical references under evidence/ and .agents/work/ preserved (83 files).

criteria.criterion: every remote provider available to KAD-PI is reachable through one OmniRoute gateway endpoint
criteria.qualification: The single-endpoint transport is live and verified for the three connections that exist: two local KAD endpoints and OpenRouter. The operator's Google AI Pro and OpenCode Go subscriptions are NOT yet connected — they need interactive OAuth consent and a credential that is not present on this host. Both lanes are already declared in the exposure policy, so they surface automatically once connected.
criteria.evidence: POST 127.0.0.1:20128/v1/models with the issued key returns 1610 ids; omp models lists 'omniroute (31)'; omniroute providers list shows 3 active connections; compute.gateway.single_endpoint PASSES.

criteria.criterion: local KAD GGUF endpoints remain KAD-owned and are only proxied, never delegated
criteria.evidence: The gateway entry is registered authority TRANSPORT_ONLY with allows_autonomous_* all false; local endpoints are registered as llama-cpp connections at 127.0.0.1:5001/5002 while admission and lifecycle stay with bin/kad-serve; omp-orchestration-preflight now excludes TRANSPORT_ONLY providers from the local-inference census so KAD never claims ownership of the gateway process (test T1b).

criteria.criterion: the KAD model catalog is refreshed deterministically and degrades without erasing qualification state
criteria.evidence: bin/kad-models sync writes config/omniroute-catalog.json whose catalog_hash is recomputed and matched by the registered validator compute.gateway.catalog_sync; a second sync prints 'unchanged' and leaves both files byte-identical; an unreachable or empty gateway throws before any write (covered by 11/11 offline tests).

criteria.criterion: no fabricated quota, cost or capability figures enter the CSA or the registry
criteria.evidence: Gateway model cost fields are all zero because /v1/models publishes no pricing; quota remains UNKNOWN with no synthesised numbers; the delegated catalog agent refused to write an empty or invented catalog when the gateway returned 401 rather than fabricating one.

criteria.criterion: the memory ISA is a first-class governed domain with deterministic validators
criteria.evidence: bin/kad-isa lint all -> ISA-KAD-MEMORY-001 lints clean in domain 'memory' with 9 claims; bin/kad-isa check all -> 33/33 claims PASS; projection_type KAD_MEMORY_ISA_PROJECTION with memory_contracts.authority_order ['SOURCE','EVIDENCE','DERIVATION']; isa-memory.json compiled into the record and mirrored.

criteria.qualification: The suites this workpackage touches are green. Three pre-existing failures remain and were proven to predate the work by running the same test file against a pristine `git archive HEAD` export: local-multi-endpoint T2/T3/T4 fail at HEAD with BLOCKED vs DEGRADED. Two further conditions are pre-existing and unchanged: bin/kad-wiki lint reports 126 errors and rebuild refuses — all 126 on files with zero git tracking at the cutoff — and the OMP orchestration preflight reports BLOCKED before and after.
criteria.evidence: node --test docs/state/test/state-artifacts.test.mjs 9/9; tools/kad/test/omniroute-catalog.test.mjs 11/11; tools/kad/test/ai-memory-adapter.test.mjs 9/9; tools/kad/test/ideal-state-traceability.test.mjs pass; /tmp/kad-head-full (git archive HEAD) reproduces T2-T4 failures.

Connect OpenCode Go: provide the subscription credential, then `omniroute providers add opencode-go --credential-env OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`, then `bin/kad-models sync`.
Decide the 123-page corpus conformance gap (bring to vault schema, or exclude from the mirror).
